title: Digital Tyre Inflator
description: Reliable, durable and accurate digital tyre inflators meeting the requirements of every vehicle tyre pressure inflation need. Used by major tyre and vehicle manufacturers in their production lines.
features: Meets accuracy standards suggested by tyre manufacturers
IP65 Ingress Protection rated control panel
Microcontroller-based system for precise pressure control

specifications.display: 4 Digit 7 Segment BIG LCD with Automatic LED backlight
specifications.inputFilter: 1/4 inch x 5 micron air filter with suitable fittings
specifications.outputAirHose: 10 meters 8x5mm Coiled PU hose with clip-on Air chuck

safetyFeatures: Separate Start and Stop keys for user safety
Pressure Regulator with Pressure Gauge for input air pressure setting
userInterface: Soft touch and durable membrane keys suitable for outdoor use
Separate keys for set pressure increment and decrement
Flat key for empty or puncture tyre
